items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I probably worked with her at the Village Vanguard or something.

ctx.x: So how did you work that out with your publishing and maintaining control of your own compositions?
Well, I was really lucky. I was really lucky. First thing happened, I was able to do, I’m assuming there’s something in that record about me recording with Nina Simone. Right?
